notes.title: Update version 1.2.2
notes.notes:
1) Fixed the difficulty selection bug in UI.
2) Fixed the magic bullet bug.

notes.title: Version 1.2.0 update, new faction added: Skeleton
notes.notes:
[h2]Update Content: [/h2]
[olist]
[*] Fixed an issue where certain creatures in multiplayer mode would exhibit inexplicable behavior after death.
[*] Balance adjustments between creatures.
[*] Added faction: Skeleton.
[/olist]

[h2]Skeleton Faction Features: [/h2]
[olist]
[*] Cheap, low health, low defense, 100% magic resistance (magic attacks cannot harm the Skeleton faction).
[*] Two cheap Skeleton mages can be used early in the game, increasing early-game tactical diversity.
[/olist]

notes.title: 1.1.2 Patch Update
notes.notes: Fixed an issue with the display animation of rewards for the ogre faction.

notes.title: 1.1.1 Patch Update
notes.notes: Fixed an issue where rewards for the ogre faction could be duplicated.

notes.title: Patch 1.1.0 update, introducing new faction 'Ogres'
notes.notes:
[h3]Content Update[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Changed texture of summoned creatures in multiplayer mode.
[*] Fixed a reward error bug in multiplayer mode.
[*] Added a new faction: Ogres. Characteristics of the Ogres faction: high health, huge size, high attack, high armor penetration.
[/olist]

[h3]Next Planned Faction Announcement[/h3]
The next faction to be added will be: The Undead Race.
Characteristics: powerful magical attack, dealing devastating damage to creatures without magical defense.

notes.title: V1.0.3 Patch Update
notes.notes:
[h3]Update Details[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Added exclusive hit effects for biological effect weapons.
[*] Modified the biological texture in single player mode.
[*] Adjusted the balance of individual creature attributes.
[/olist]

[h3]Next Update Details[/h3>

[*] Add a new faction: the ogres.

The next update is expected to be completed within 2 days.
